adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, the diff shows `usernames.split(",").each do |username| if user = User.find_by_username(username) group.add(user) end end` followed by `render json: success_json` if `group.save` succeeds. This will indeed silently ignore unknown usernames (including ones with stray spaces) and still return success, so the client can’t tell whether some/all adds were skipped. However, this behavior also existed in the removed `update_patch` path (it also skipped missing users and returned `success_json`), and the diff even removes a spec that asserted silent success when adding a non-existent user—suggesting it’s an intentional/accepted behavior rather than a newly introduced correctness defect.
